title: 第21章 被校领导们注意第22章 茫然的气象局
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
四散的人群由于冰雹的到来，显得像无头苍蝇似的乱窜。
更有一些反应慢的人，已经被冰雹砸到，并且受了伤。
正在躲避的校领导们的脸上，已经不见先前的不悦，充满着惊疑不定。
“竟然真的让他说中了！”
“明明天气预报上显示，这一整个周几乎都是晴天，他怎么可能比天气预报测的还准？能预知冰雹的到来？”
“不会真的是画阵求来的吧？”
“开什么玩笑！”
“还是说他有什么观天象之类的本事？”
混乱之中，大家都跑向了不同的地方。
不过还好除了几名外伤的人之外，并没有人受重伤，因为在此之前，同学们已经跑了很多。
这场冰雹持续的时间并不久，也就不到几分钟的时间，便又变成了雨水。
室外的停车场里，老师们停着的私家车，也有不少没有逃得了冰雹的毒手的。
校领导们一脸狼狈的坐在会议室中，看着主位上坐着的沉着脸一言不发的校长，等待着校长开口发言。
校长先是喝了一口面前杯子里的热水，这才觉得，被寒风吹得难受的身子稍微暖和了些。
而后郑志安皱着眉头，对在场的人说道：
“这场突如其来的天气情况，对咱们烟海市来说，也是近几年都罕见的一次极端天气了。”
“好在时间短，造不成危害。”
“先让各校区的人，把学生受伤的情况统计上来，并且一定要安排好受伤学生的治疗。”
“关于损毁的东西，记录完全之后也及时汇报，需要换新的及时换新，维修的及时维修。”
郑志安作为一校之主，首先便将应对工作先安排好。

而后才看了一圈校领导们，开口问道：
“现在知道沉默是金了？”
“要是早早的听了林楠同学的话，现在也不会有人员伤亡的事情出现！”
“当老师的，不能觉得自己所有的想法都是对的，学生的意见有时候也是很重要的！”
在座的校领导们，都低头听着校长的批评，没有一个人敢反驳校长的话的。
见状，校长才继续说道：
“好了，现在都说说，对于这场冰雹你们有什么看法？”
闻言，学校的各位领导们也都回想起了刚刚在操场上发生的事情。
他们互相看了看，然后才开口说道：
“这次的冰雹下得确实太突然了。”
“在定下了这次早会的时候，我们就提前好几天关注天气预报，但是一直都显示今天是晴天，别说是冰雹了，连雨水都没有预报到。”
“是啊，咱们学校的活动，一向都会提前做充足的准备，以防意外发生，却没想到这次竟然在做足了准备的情况下，还能发生今天这样的意外情况。”
校领导们都在说着这场意外，却没有人认为这一切的发生真的与林楠有关。
要说画阵求雨什么的，他们肯定是不相信的！
不过这个学生，应该确实有些本事在身上。
“确实多亏了他，要不是他的提醒，不可能将受伤情况控制在个位数，这名学生虽然扰乱了早会的进行，但倒真是办了件好事。”
“在回来的路上，我听到有学生提起，他在网上直播扮演神仙？而且扮演的那位神仙，好像就是，掌管云雨雷电之类自然气象的雷祖天尊。”
content_en:
The scattered crowds seemed to be scurrying around like headless flies due to the arrival of hail.
Some people who were slow to react had already been hit by hailstones and injured.
The faces of the school leaders who were taking refuge no longer showed the displeasure they had before, but were full of surprise and uncertainty.
"He actually got it right!"
"Obviously the weather forecast shows that it will be almost sunny this whole week. How could he be more accurate than the weather forecast? Can he predict the arrival of hail?"
"You can't really ask for it from Hua Zhen, right?"
"What a joke!"
"Or does he have some ability to observe the sky?"
In the chaos, everyone ran to different places.
Fortunately, except for a few people with external injuries, no one was seriously injured, because before that, the students had already run a lot.
The hailstorm didn't last long, and within a few minutes, it turned into rain again.
In the outdoor parking lot, many private cars parked by teachers could not escape the hail.
The school leaders sat in the conference room with embarrassed faces, looking at the sullen and silent principal sitting in the main seat, waiting for the principal to speak.
The principal first took a sip of hot water from the cup in front of him, and then he felt that his body, which was uncomfortable with the cold wind, was slightly warmer.
Then Zheng Zhian frowned and said to the people present:
"This sudden weather situation is also an extreme weather event that has been rare in Yanhai City in recent years."
"Fortunately, the time is short and no harm will be caused."
"First, let people from each campus compile statistics on student injuries, and be sure to make arrangements for the treatment of injured students."
"As for damaged things, they should be reported in a timely manner after the records are complete. If they need to be replaced, they should be replaced in a timely manner, and if they need to be repaired, they should be repaired in a timely manner."
As the head of a school, Zheng Zhian first arranged the response work.
Then he looked around at the school leaders and asked:
"Now you know silence is golden?"
"If I had listened to Lin Nan earlier, there would be no casualties now!"
"As a teacher, you can't think that all your ideas are right. Sometimes students' opinions are also very important!"
The school leaders present all lowered their heads and listened to the principal's criticism. No one dared to refute the principal's words.
Seeing this, the principal continued:
"Okay, now let's talk about it, what do you think about this hailstorm?"
Hearing this, the school leaders also recalled what had just happened on the playground.
They looked at each other and then said:
"The hail fell really suddenly this time."
"When we scheduled this morning meeting, we paid attention to the weather forecast several days in advance, but it always showed that it would be sunny today, not to mention hail, and even rain was not forecast."
"Yes, we always make adequate preparations for school activities in advance to prevent accidents from happening, but I didn't expect that an unexpected situation like today would happen this time despite being fully prepared."
The school leaders were all talking about the accident, but no one thought that it was really related to Lin Nan.
If you ask me to draw a formation to pray for rain, they will definitely not believe it!
But this student should indeed have some abilities.
"Thanks to him indeed. Without his reminder, it would have been impossible to control the injuries to single digits. Although this student disrupted the morning meeting, he did a good thing."
"On the way back, I heard a student mention that he was playing the role of a god in an online live broadcast? And the god he played seemed to be Lei Zutianzun, who is in charge of natural weather such as clouds, rain, thunder and lightning."
